recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, utilizing extreme lighting to create deep shadows and bright highlights, paired with heavy, wide slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a diagonal shadow across the face, focusing attention on one eye.
The white clothing and hat blend into the bright background areas, creating a 'blown-out' high-key effect.
The heavy black typography at the bottom anchors the composition against the dark background elements.
The subject's gaze is directed slightly upward and towards the viewer, creating an intimate connection.
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette (black, white, and grayscale).
Extreme chiaroscuro lighting with minimal mid-tone detail in the background.
Presence of a wide-brimmed hat as a primary compositional element.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned off-center, filling the right two-thirds of the frame in a tight close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the hat brim down to the subject's face, then drops to the large horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of solid black on the left and solid white on the right create a stark, graphic balance.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white for highlights and background areas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and negative space.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle gray mid-tones for facial contouring.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; maximum value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif with heavy strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Spurred or notched details in the center of vertical strokes for a 'western' feel

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Two-line stack for name; single line for title

composition.overlap: Text overlaps the subject's clothing at the bottom

treatment.fill: Solid Black or Solid White (inverted based on background)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales and positions for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and wide stance.
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight.
Offers the classic blocky western feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man wearing a white cowboy hat. Use chiaroscuro lighting so the left side of the frame is deep black and the right side is bright white. The hat brim should cast a sharp diagonal shadow across the face, leaving only one eye clearly visible. The man should have a slight, knowing smile.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, all-caps, extended slab-serif text. Place the primary name in the top-left corner in white against the black background. Place the secondary title in black across the bottom, centered, overlapping the white clothing.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the typography a heavy, wide slab serif?
Does the hat brim create a strong diagonal shadow?
Is the lighting high-contrast with blown-out whites?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the shadow across the face
Ratio of black to white negative space
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the visible eye
Clean, crisp edges on the typography
Dramatic tonal range from pure black to pure white

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the high-contrast background.
Check that the shadow doesn't completely obscure the subject's expression.
Verify the slab serifs are blocky and not rounded.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the off-center subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast chiaroscuro portrait with heavy, extended slab-serif typography for a bold, graphic, and modern-western aesthetic.
